schema: CREATE TABLE department (dept_name INT, building INT, budget INT); CREATE TABLE teaches (id INT, year INT, semester INT); CREATE TABLE course (course_id INT, dept_name INT, credits INT);
correct_query: SELECT T.semester, SUM(C.credits) FROM department AS D INNER JOIN teaches AS T ON D.budget = T.year + 4 INNER JOIN course AS C ON C.dept_name = D.dept_name GROUP BY T.semester HAVING AVG(C.credits) > 2 AND COUNT(D.building) = 2;
